rationale: Old English GÝME (related to gíeman, "to heed, care for") carries the sense of directing one's mind or notice toward something — i.e., the active process of concentrating on or attending to something. This aligns best with attention.n.01 (the process of concentrating on features of the environment). While care.n.01 is possible given the semantic overlap in Old English between "care" and "attention," the gloss token here is specifically "attention" and the active cognitive/noticing sense of attention.n.01 fits the heeding/noticing semantic field of GÝME.
